column3: Description

Build the endpoint that generates an invitelink for a given contact and records that an invite was sent (so the app knowsto show "Invited" afterward). Should route an opened invite link intothe signup flow correctly, whether or not the invited person already has theapp installed.

column2: Send and Receive Messages in Real Time
column3: Asa user, I want to send and receive messages instantly in a conversation, sothat I can have real-time conversations with the people I chat with. This is thefoundation everything else in the chat engine sits on top of calling, translation,and file sharing are all extensions of a conversation that has to already workreliably in real time.Acceptance Criteria● A message sent by one user appears in theother person's conversation, without either person needingto refresh or reopen the app● Message delivery status is accurate andupdates correctly (sent ➡ delivered ➡ read), matching the states alreadydesigned for the Chat screen● Reopening a conversation shows the fullmessage history in the correct order● Messaging remains reliable on typical mobiledata, not just Wi-Fi
Build the backend service that deliversmessages between users in real time, stores message history, and tracks eachmessage's status as it moves from sent to delivered to read.
Build the conversation screen that displays sentand received messages in order, includes the message input bar, and reflectseach message's delivery/read status as it updates in real time

Asa user, I want to see what the other person is typing as they type it, so thatour conversation feels immediate and natural, rather than waiting on a generic"typing…" indicator.This is adeliberate differentiator from standard chat apps, it's meant to make conversationson Beevia feel more like being on a call together than exchanging texts.Acceptance Criteria● While the other person is composing a message,I see their text appear and update live in the conversation, in real time, asthey type● If they edit or delete what they've typedbefore sending, my view updates to match● If they stop typing or close the app withoutsending, the live preview clears● The experience feels responsive, withoutnoticeable lag between their keystrokes and what I see
Build the real-time channel that streams auser's in-progress draft text to the other participant as they type, updatinglive and clearing appropriately when they stop typing or send the message.

column2: Live Typing Display in Chat Thread
column3: Render the other participant's live draft textwithin the conversation thread as it streams in, updating in real time andclearing it once they stop typing or send.

Asa user, I want to make and receive voice calls with someone I'm chatting with,so that I can talk to them directly without leaving the app.Acceptance Criteria● A user can start a voice call with any contactfrom within their conversation with that person● The other person gets a clear incoming-callnotification and can accept or decline● Call quality holds up on typical mobile data,not just Wi-Fi● Either person can end the call from their sideat any time● A record of the call (missed or answered, andduration) shows up in the conversation history afterward

Set up the backend calling infrastructure, includingcall signaling, session management, and logging call records (missed, answered,duration) to the conversation history. LiveKit to be used as the supporting provider
Build the audio call experience, including theoutgoing call screen, the incoming call/ringing screen with accept and declineactions, in-call controls, and ending the call.

Asa user, I want to make and receive video calls with someone I'm chatting with,so that I can have face-to-face conversations through the app.Acceptance Criteria● Everything in the Audio Calling story applies here as well● A user can turn their camera on/off during acall● A user can switch between front and backcamera during a call● Video quality holds up reasonably well ontypical mobile data
Extend the calling infrastructure built foraudio calls (CE3-BE) to support video sessions.
Build the video call experience, includingcamera preview, camera on/off toggle, switching between front and back camera,and the video call screen layout.

column2: Share Files, Photos, Contacts, and Location in Chat
column3: Asa user, I want to send documents, photos, a contact card, or my location tosomeone I'm chatting with, so that I can share more than just text when aconversation calls for it such as sending an ID document, sharing a photo, or sending directions tomeet someone.Acceptance Criteria● A user can attach and send a document (e.g. aPDF) in a conversation, and the recipient can open or download it● A user can attach and send one or more photos,viewable directly in the conversation● A user can share a contact from their phone asa card the recipient can view (and save to their own contacts)● A user can share their current location, or achosen location, as a shareable map location● All shared content appears in the conversationhistory with the correct sender and timestamp, the same as a text message would

Build the upload and storage endpoints andmessage types needed to support sending documents, photos, contact cards, andlocation within a conversation, and ensure they're retrievable as part of theconversation history.
Build the attachment picker for documents,photos, contacts, and location, and the inline display of each shared file within the chat thread.

Asa user, I want the app to check my phone contacts to see who's already onBeevia, and be able to invite the ones who aren't, so that I can start chattingwith people I know whether or not they've joined the app yetMost people's contact lists will includeplenty of people who aren't on Beevia yet, without a way to invite themdirectly from that same list, discovery only solves half the problem and givesthe app no natural way to grow through word of mouthAcceptance Criteria ● The user is asked to grant permission toaccess their phone contacts, with a clear explanation of why before the systempermission prompt appears● If permission is granted, the user's contactsare checked against Beevia's user base to identify which of them are already onthe app● Contacts who are on Beevia are shown in adiscoverable list, clearly distinguished from contacts who aren't yet on theapp● The user can start a new 1:1 conversationdirectly from this list, for any discovered contact● Re-syncing happens periodically,so contacts who join Beevia later become discoverable without the user needingto do anything, like updating the app● Contacts who are NOT on Beevia show an"Invite" action in the same list, instead of a way to start a chat● Tapping Invite lets the user send that contacta link to join Beevia (via sms), opening the invite link should take the invited personinto the Beevia signup flow (directing them to install the app if they don'thave it, or opening the app directly if they do)● Once a contact has been invited, the listreflects that (e.g. shows "Invited" instead of the Invite action), sothe user has a clear sense of who they've already reached out to

Design the full discovery flow: apermission-priming screen explaining why contact access is requested (shownbefore the native OS prompt), the synced-contacts list showing who's on Beeviavs. not, the fallback state for when permission is denied, and the empty statefor when no contacts are found on Beevia yet.

Build the backend logic to accept a user'scontact list (phone numbers) and match them against registered Beevia users,returning which contacts are already on the platform. Needs to handle thissecurely and privately (e.g. hashing phone numbers rather than storing rawcontact data beyond what's necessary) and support periodic re-sync as new usersjoin.

Implement the permission priming screen, thenative OS contact permission request, uploading the device's contact list tothe sync endpoint, displaying the discovered contacts list, handling thepermission denied path gracefully, and starting a new conversation from adiscovered contact.

Design the Invite action shown next tocontacts who aren't on Beevia within the same discovered-contacts list, theshare/send-invite interaction, and the "Invited" state a contactshows afterward so the user can see who they've already reached out to.

DescriptionLandingscreen shown before account creation or login. column2: Phone Number Entry + Country Picker + Register Integration

Collects country (via searchable picker with dial code) andphone number, then triggers the signup OTP.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/auth/register Acceptance Criteria● Country picker defaults to device locale /IP-detected country where available, otherwise Nigeria● Country picker is searchable ("Searchcountry" field) and shows flag + name + dial code per row, as inPhone_Verification___Countries● Selecting a country updates the dial-codeprefix shown beside the phone field● App composes the full E.164 number (dial code+ local digits) client-side before calling the API● "Send Code" CTA disabled until astructurally valid phone number is entered● On success, navigate to OTP Verification passing phone, countryCode, and purpose=signup● On 400 validation_error, show the inline errorstate per Phone_Verification___Error without losing entered data● Loading state shown on the CTA

Description6-digit code entry componentAPI IntegrationPOST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request Acceptance Criteria● 6 individual digit boxes, auto-advance focusper digit, supports SMS autofill (iOS 'From Messages' suggestion strip /Android SMS Retriever API)● Countdown shown during resend cooldown("Resend in 00:30"); "Resend Code" becomes tappable once itelapses● On otp_invalid/otp_expired, show the redinline error state per the error-state design and clear the entered digits● On otp_too_many_attempts, show an error anddisable further verify attempts for a cooldown window (confirm exact durationwith backend)● On otp_cooldown from a resend tap, surface theexact wait-time message returned by the API● On successful verify: persistaccess_token/refresh_token securely and route by purpose — signup → PIN Setup(A4); login → onboarding-resume logic (A7)

column2: PIN Setup Screen + Biometrics + Set PIN Integration
column3: DescriptionFirst-time4-digit PIN creation with an optional biometrics opt-in, immediately aftersignup OTP verification.API IntegrationsPOST /api/v1/auth/pinRequest:{ pin: 4-digit string, enableBiometrics?: boolean }Success:200: user with onboarding_step: pin_set, pin_set: true Acceptance Criteria● "PIN" and "Confirm PIN", two independent 4-box inputs● Continue disabled until both are 4 digits andmatch; inline mismatch error shown on submit if they differ● "Enable Biometrics" toggle shownonly when the device supports Face ID / fingerprint; include enableBiometricsin the request only when toggled on● On success, persist the updateduser/onboarding_step and hand off to the path-selection routing logic● If biometrics was enabled, register the devicecredential locally (Face ID / Touch ID / Android BiometricPrompt) for futureunlock, gated on the OS having biometrics enrolled

column2: Login Flow (Returning Users): Phone + OTP Integration
column3: DescriptionLogin nowcollects only a phone number, then reuses the OTP verification component with purpose=login. All PIN-on-login and Forgot Password UI has been confirmedremoved.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/auth/loginRequest:{ phone } Acceptance Criteria● Phone number field ● CTA calls /auth/login; on the (always-200)response, navigate to OTP Verification with purpose=login● On successful OTP verify for purpose=login,use the returned user.onboarding_step to route via the resume logic (Onboarding resume logic); ifonboarding is already complete, go straight to the Chat screen

DescriptionSharednetworking-layer ticket implementing secure storage, attachment, and rotationof access/refresh tokens, plus the standardized response-envelope parsing usedby every other ticket in this set.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/auth/refreshRequest:{ refreshToken }Success:200: { access_token, refresh_token } (rotated) POST /api/v1/auth/logoutRequest:{ refreshToken }Success:200: { logged_out: true }: idempotent GET /api/v1/auth/meSuccess:200: current user + onboarding stateErrors:401 unauthorized Acceptance Criteria● access_token / refresh_token stored in securedevice storage (Keychain on iOS, EncryptedSharedPreferences/Keystore onAndroid)● All authenticated requests attachAuthorization: Bearer <access_token> via a shared interceptor● On any 401, attempt POST /auth/refresh exactlyonce using the stored refresh token, then retry the original request; on asecond failure (refresh_invalid/session_invalid), clear the session and routeto the Welcome screen● Always persist the new refresh_token returnedby /auth/refresh, treat it as single-use/rotating● Shared response-envelope parser implementedonce ({ success, message, data, meta?, timestamp } / { success:false, message,error, details?, timestamp }) and reused by every networking call in thisticket set, rather than parsed ad hoc per screen

DescriptionEnsures auser who closes the app mid-onboarding, or logs in on a new device, resumes atthe correct step using the server as source of truth rather than local-onlystate.API IntegrationGET /api/v1/onboarding/stateSuccess:200: current onboarding_step + chosen path Acceptance Criteria● Call GET /onboarding/state on app launch (witha valid stored session) and immediately after OTP verify for an existing user● Map the returned state to a screen:phone_verified -> PIN Setup; pin_set with path still null -> Path Selection if country_code is NG, else silently assign chat_only and go to Basic Info; path chosen but profile/KYC incomplete -> resume at the correct banking orchat-only step; fully complete -> Chat screen● This mapping must be exhaustive over the fullonboarding_step enum

column2: Path Selection Screen (Nigeria-Only Gating) + Choose Path Integration
column3: DescriptionCentralbusiness-rule ticket for the whole set: this screen is shown only to userswhose country_code (captured at registration) is NG. Every other user skipsit and is auto-assigned the chat-only path.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/onboarding/pathRequest:{ path: "chat_only" | "chat_banking" }Success:200 → updated user Acceptance Criteria● After PIN Setup (A4), branch onuser.country_code: if "NG": show this screen with two equal-weightcards ("Chat Only" / "Chat + Banking"), no cardpre-selected, Continue disabled until one is tapped● If country_code is not "NG", skipthis screen entirely; silently call POST /onboarding/path with { path:"chat_only" }, then navigate straight to Basic Info. No bankingoption, copy, or screen is ever shown to non-Nigerian users, banking isNigeria-only for this release● Selecting "Chat Only" + Continue -> call the API with chat_only -> navigate to Basic Info● Selecting "Chat + Banking" +Continue -> call the API with chat_banking -> navigate to the Naira Wallet Intro● On API failure, keep the user on this screenwith a retry affordance, do not advance navigation until the call succeeds● Implement the country-based gating in a singleshared onboarding-coordinator function, not duplicated per screen, so futurecountry expansion for banking is a one-line change

column2: Basic Info Screen (Chat-Only Path) + Submit Profile Integration
column3: DescriptionCollects nameand date of birth to complete onboarding for chat-only users, reached bothdirectly (Nigerian users who chose Chat Only) and via the silentauto-assignment for non-Nigerian usersAPI IntegrationPOST /api/v1/onboarding/profile Acceptance Criteria● First Name / Last Name text fields; DOBcollected via Day / Month / Year fields as shown in Figma, transform toYYYY-MM-DD before calling the API regardless of the input control used● Continue disabled until all fields holdplausible values● On age_below_minimum, route to the Age-Gatescreen rather than showing an inline field error -> this is the confirmedproduct behavior for under-16 users● On success, this is the end of onboarding forchat-only users: clear the onboarding navigation stack and route to the Chatscreen● Copy must remain path-neutral (nobanking/wallet references) since this screen serves both the direct chat-onlychoice and the silent non-Nigerian auto-assignment

column2: Naira Wallet Intro + Email Entry + Send Email Code Integration

column2: BVN Entry Screen + BVN Lookup Integration
column3: DescriptionCollects the11-digit BVN and confirms it exists, returning the availableownership-verification methods.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/kyc/bvnRequest:{ bvn: 11-digit string }Success:200: BVN found, returns available methods (face / record; phone not yetsupported)Errors:400 bvn_not_found Acceptance Criteria● 11 individual digit boxes, numeric keyboardonly; Continue disabled until all 11 are entered● Only reachable once email verification has succeeded● On bvn_not_found, show an inline error and allowre-entry without losing the verified-email state

column3: DescriptionIn-app cameracapture with a face-guide overlay; submits the selfie alongside the BVN forownership verification.API IntegrationPOST /api/v1/kyc/bvn/verify-ownershipRequest:{ bvn, method: "face", selfieImage: base64/data-URL }Acceptance Criteria● In-app camera view with an oval face-guideoverlay matching the Figma framing● "Take Selfie" captures,compresses/encodes the image (base64 or data-URL), and submits it with thepreviously-entered bvn and method: "face"● Show the Verifying modal while therequest is in flight● On face_verification_failed, return to thisscreen with a retry affordance and clear guidance (e.g. "We couldn'tverify your face, try again in better lighting")● On method_unavailable, handle defensively witha fallback message directing the user to contact support● On success, the ownership-verificationresponse is the source of the KYC profile data auto-submitted, nouser-facing step happens between this screen and Wallet Ready beyond theVerifying modal

Asa user, I want to turn read receipts on or off for a specific conversation, sothat I can control whether that person sees when I've read their messages,without it affecting any of my other conversations.Most chatapps only let you control read receipts app-wide. Beevia is doing this per conversation instead.Acceptance Criteria● From a specific conversation's settings, auser can turn read receipts on or off for that conversation only● Read receipts are on by default for everyconversation, matching the existing delivered/read behavior already built, this is an opt-out setting, not opt-in● When turned off for a conversation, the otherparticipant stops seeing a "read" status for that user's messages inthat conversation, their messages appear as delivered, not read, even onceactually read● Turning read receipts off for a conversationalso removes that user's own visibility into the other participant's readstatus for that same conversation, matching the standard reciprocal pattern(you only see theirs if you're also sharing yours).● The change applies immediately going forward;when turned off, previously-shown "read" statuses for thatconversation should also be hidden retroactively, so the setting behavesconsistently rather than leaving old read receipts visible
Design where this toggle lives within aconversation's settings/overflow menu, and how the on/off state is communicatedclearly to the user.

Store the read-receipt preference perconversation (not app-wide), and ensure the message status logic respects it, withholding or showing "read" status accordingly,including the reciprocal hide both ways behavior.
Build the toggle UI within conversationsettings, and ensure the chat thread reflects the correct read-statusvisibility (or lack thereof) based on the setting.
